description: Land Acquisition - Rilawala & Undurugoda, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific parcels of land are needed for a public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land lots with their boundaries, extents, and locations. The content focuses exclusively on land matters (acquisition for public purpose) without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories like legal, commercial, or electoral matters.
